cases.prompt: No web lookups please, just your knowledge and skills. I'm building a custom Collector with OCB to match collector-contrib v0.165.1. The manifest needs the otlp receiver, the k8sattributes and tail_sampling processors, the otlp exporter, and the file and env config providers. Which OCB version and which exact module versions go in builder.yaml, and can I download a prebuilt ocb binary for that release? Also, is k8sattributes stable?
expectations: Uses OCB v0.165.0 (no v0.165.1 OCB or core release exists) and pins the core otlp receiver and otlp exporter at v0.165.0.
Pins tailsamplingprocessor at the contrib patch v0.165.1.
Pins the file and env providers at v1.71.0.
Pins k8sattributesprocessor at v1.4.1 (the stable-base version tagged with contrib v0.165.1), not v0.165.1 or v0.165.0.
Says a prebuilt ocb release binary and builder image were published as 0.165.0 as of the recorded date, and also offers go install of cmd/builder@v0.165.0.

Frames the versions as verified on the recorded date rather than as currently latest, and suggests confirming against the release's builder default.yaml, contrib's module tags, or the collector-releases otelcol-contrib manifest before deploying.
Does not perform any web search, web fetch, or network command.
